items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I used to listen to Jesse Crawford

ctx.x: Do you know what their names were?

I don't even remember, I never came in contact with them again. In fact, I'm going to tell you something, they gave me my first assignment, my four arrangements. Okay. I'm saying how on earth do you write for the Hammond organ? So I spent the rest of that day trying to contact different arrangers that I knew, I mean good arrangers. Jesse Stone, Don Redman, everybody, I said, look -- I even went to Hammond Organ himself, I said I just wanted to see -- I know how the music is supposed to sound because I used to…
